author: Bobby Grayson
description: The ordered field is an invariant over the server's mailbox *list*, not counts. Preservation needed exact mailbox equations (mboxOf_deliverAll_eq) rather than mcount. The general append lemma relBeforeAcq_append handles every send with one side condition: appending release h requires no pending acquire h, which follows from hd=1 -> a=0 in the token invariant.
title: FIFO is finally load-bearing, and in exactly the place predicted three sessions ago: the reorder 'acquire h while h holds' is harmless for safety and deadlock freedom but breaks rank accounting. The proof that excludes it uses only the tail-append shape of Step.chars' mailbox clause
